correctness.rationale: An injective vertex ordering of K_(m,n) yields strong pairs precisely when the descending neighbor set has size one; its matching is contained in one target simplex T_v or one mixed cone F^A/F^B_(a,b). Conversely each listed facet is realized by an ordering. A mixed-target nontrivial face belongs to exactly one such cone, allowing the stated descending-size free-pair collapses to single bridges; all disjoint target simplices then collapse to trees. The final connected graph has 2mn vertices, 4mn-m-n edges and cycle rank 2mn-m-n+1. Independently enumerated all vertex orders and matched their face closures with proposed facet family at (2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(3,4). Actual verifier source also describes explicit free-pair checking.
